analytics.name: Prismor new unauthenticated Copilot Studio agent
analytics.query:
let window = 1h;
let prior = PrismorAIInventory_CL
  | where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(window))
  | where Kind == "lowcode_agent"
  | where set_has_element(RiskSignalIds, "NO_AUTH")
  | distinct EntityKey;
PrismorAIInventory_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(window)
| where Kind == "lowcode_agent" and InventorySource == "lowcode.copilot_studio"
| where set_has_element(RiskSignalIds, "NO_AUTH")
| join kind=leftanti prior on EntityKey
| summarize arg_max(ObservedAt, *) by EntityKey
| project ObservedAt, Name, PowerPlatformEnvironmentId, EntraTenantId, RiskScore, RiskSignalIds, GovernedBy, RecordId

analytics.name: Prismor new MCP server on an endpoint
analytics.query:
let window = 1h;
let prior = PrismorAIInventory_CL
  | where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(window))
  | where Kind == "mcp_server" and Surface == "endpoint"
  | distinct HostId, EntityKey;
PrismorAIInventory_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(window)
| where Kind == "mcp_server" and Surface == "endpoint"
| join kind=leftanti prior on HostId, EntityKey
| summarize arg_max(ObservedAt, *) by HostId, EntityKey
| extend Unmanaged = not(Managed)
| project ObservedAt, Hostname, HostId, UserHash, Name, Product, Path, Scope, Unmanaged, RiskScore, RiskSignalIds

analytics.name: Prismor secret or API key exposure by an agent
analytics.query:
let secretRules = dynamic(["mcp-hardcoded-secret", "copilot-studio-credential-in-arguments", "cloaked-secret-in-url", "cloaked-secret-in-mcp-args"]);
union
(PrismorAgentEvents_CL
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
  | where Category in ("secret_exfiltration", "secret_access") or RuleId in (secretRules)
  | summarize Events=dcount(EventId), Blocked=dcountif(EventId, Action == "block"), Rules=make_set(RuleId, 20), FirstSeen=min(EventTime), LastSeen=max(EventTime) by Hostname, Subject, Agent
  | extend Source = "runtime"),
(PrismorAIInventory_CL
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
  | where set_has_element(RiskSignalIds, "SECRET_IN_CONFIG")
  | summarize arg_max(ObservedAt, *) by RecordId
  | project Hostname, Subject=UserHash, Agent=Product, Rules=pack_array("SECRET_IN_CONFIG"), FirstSeen=ObservedAt, LastSeen=ObservedAt, Events=1, Blocked=0
  | extend Source = "inventory")

analytics.name: Prismor policy-deny spike
analytics.query:
let baseline = PrismorAgentEvents_CL
  | where TimeGenerated between (ago(7d) .. ago(1h)) and Action == "block"
  | summarize Blocks=dcount(EventId) by Hostname, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
  | summarize AvgPerHour=avg(Blocks), StdPerHour=stdev(Blocks) by Hostname;
PrismorAgentEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and Action == "block"
| summarize Blocks=dcount(EventId), Rules=make_set(RuleId, 20), Categories=make_set(Category, 20) by Hostname, Subject, Agent
| join kind=leftouter baseline on Hostname
| extend Threshold = max_of(10.0, coalesce(AvgPerHour, 0.0) + 3.0 * coalesce(StdPerHour, 0.0))
| where Blocks > Threshold
| project Hostname, Subject, Agent, Blocks, Threshold, AvgPerHour, Rules, Categories

analytics.name: Prismor sensor gap
analytics.query:
let seen7d = PrismorAgentEvents_CL
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by Hostname;
seen7d
| where LastSeen < ago(24h)
| project Hostname, LastSeen, HoursSilent = datetime_diff('hour', now(), LastSeen)

hunting.name: Inventory by kind, surface, and managed
hunting.query:
PrismorAIInventory_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize arg_max(ObservedAt, *) by RecordId
| summarize Items=dcount(RecordId) by Kind, Surface, Managed

hunting.name: Unmanaged items per user
hunting.query:
PrismorAIInventory_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Managed == false
| summarize arg_max(ObservedAt, *) by RecordId
| summarize Items=dcount(RecordId) by UserHash, Hostname
| join kind=leftouter (IdentityInfo) on $left.UserHash == $right.AccountUpn

hunting.name: Agent events for a session
hunting.query:
PrismorAgentEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where SessionId != ""
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EventId
| sort by SessionSeq asc
| project EventTime, SessionId, SessionSeq, RuleId, Action, Severity, FindingTitle, Hostname, Subject

hunting.name: Copilot Studio agents and admin activity
hunting.query:
// TODO(verify): HMLR may have PowerPlatformAdminActivity, CloudAppEvents, or neither.
// This hunting query uses PowerPlatformAdminActivity. It is not a scheduled rule.
PrismorAIInventory_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where Kind == "lowcode_agent" and InventorySource == "lowcode.copilot_studio"
| summarize arg_max(ObservedAt, *) by EntityKey
| join kind=leftouter (
    PowerPlatformAdminActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | project TimeGenerated, Name=OperationName
  ) on Name
| project ObservedAt, Name, EntraTenantId, PowerPlatformEnvironmentId, RiskScore
